paragraphs.en: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
paragraphs.zh: VoiceStudio 是开源的、完全本地化的 ElevenLabs 替代方案——支持 646 种语言的语音克隆、声音设计、视频配音、听写、转录与有声书制作。

paragraphs.en: Open-source voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
paragraphs.zh: 开源的语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、口述、转录与有声书创作工具，支持 646 种语言。

paragraphs.en: Start with VoiceStudio (default, powered by k2-fsa/OmniVoice), or choose another engine. Features & engine catalog .
paragraphs.zh: 从 VoiceStudio 开始（默认，由 k2-fsa/OmniVoice 驱动），或选择其他引擎。 功能与引擎目录。

paragraphs.en: Local workflows run on your hardware. Remote services are optional; usage analytics requires consent.
paragraphs.zh: 本地工作流在你的硬件上运行。 远程服务为可选项；使用情况分析需要征得同意。

paragraphs.en: OmniVoice GGUF source builds can optionally use Vulkan on Windows and Linux; see the native engine guide for build requirements, CPU fallback, and device overrides.
paragraphs.zh: OmniVoice GGUF 源码构建在 Windows 和 Linux 上可选择使用 Vulkan；构建要求、CPU 回退以及设备覆盖设置请参阅原生引擎指南。

paragraphs.en: # Latest Electron release curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh # A specific published Electron release (replace X.Y.Z) curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --version X.Y.Z # Build current main and install the desktop app curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --main # Uninstall the app, keeping your data curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --uninstall On Windows, run irm https://voicestudio.sh/install | iex in PowerShell.
paragraphs.zh: # 最新 Electron 发行版 curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh # 指定某个已发布的 Electron 发行版（替换 X.Y.Z） curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --version X.Y.Z # 构建当前 main 分支并安装桌面应用 curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --main # 卸载应用，但保留你的数据 curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --uninstall 在 Windows 上，请在 PowerShell 中运行 irm https://voicestudio.sh/install | iex。

paragraphs.en: If voicestudio.sh/install is unreachable or returns 404, run the same script straight from the repository, or clone it and run scripts/install.sh :

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/main/scripts/install.sh | sh Release downloads require curl and a SHA-256 tool. --main requires Git, Node.js 22+, Bun, Rust/Cargo, and platform build tools; see installer prerequisites and behavior . The installer preserves your settings, projects, and models. Older versions must contain Electron packages; it never falls back to archived Tauri builds.
Or download from Releases (macOS .dmg , Windows .exe , Linux .AppImage or .deb ) and follow your platform guide:
Open Voice cloning , choose a voice or add a clean reference recording, enter your text, and generate. Install the required model when prompted. Hardware needs vary by engine; see performance .
Paste into your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …):

Install the VoiceStudio Electron app on this device and verify it works, following https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/main/docs/install/agent.md The agent guide covers hardware detection, reusing existing data, asking before model downloads, and a test generation. Agents that support skills can also run npx skills add debpalash/VoiceStudio .

git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git cd VoiceStudio bun install bun run setup:api # prepare Python dependencies before starting Electron bun run dev See Electron setup for prerequisites and backend configuration.
Use bun run smoke-test to build and launch an isolated packaged Electron app. Add -- --install for the networked managed-runtime installation check.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 bun run smoke-test 来构建并启动一个隔离的打包 Electron 应用。 添加 -- --install 以进行联网的托管运行时安装检查。

sents.en: Add -- --install for the networked managed-runtime installation check.
sents.zh: 添加 -- --install 以进行联网的托管运行时安装检查。

paragraphs.en: Electron is the only desktop app and web UI. Version 0.5.3 was the final Tauri release. Existing Tauri users must install Electron separately . The retired Tauri shell and legacy UI entry points have been removed.
paragraphs.zh: Electron 是唯一的桌面应用和 Web UI。 0.5.3 版本是 Tauri 的最终发布版本。 现有的 Tauri 用户必须单独安装 Electron。 已弃用的 Tauri 外壳和旧版 UI 入口点已被移除。

paragraphs.en: AGPL-3.0 covers the application, including commercial use under its conditions. Model weights, tokenizers, voices and generated-output conditions are separate; a paid app licence does not grant those rights. Clone voices only with permission. Model Manager now shows versioned model-source notices, evidence links and unresolved review gaps from the shared inventory . Its optional reviewed-file preview does not enforce ordinary downloads or certify commercial permission. See license details .
paragraphs.zh: AGPL-3.0 涵盖该应用程序，包括在其条件下的商业使用。 模型权重、分词器、语音以及生成输出的条件是分开的；付费的应用许可并不授予这些权利。 仅在获得许可的情况下克隆语音。 模型管理器现在显示来自共享清单的版本化模型来源声明、证据链接以及未解决的审查缺口。 其可选的已审查文件预览不会强制执行普通下载，也不会认证商业使用许可。详情请参阅许可说明。
